card.partySizeHelp: Unaweza kuja na hadi {max, plural, one {mtu #} other {watu #}}
card.rsvpConfirmedBody: Tumehifadhi jibu lako: {people}. Onyesha QR hii au namba yako mlangoni.
card.rsvpDeclinedBody: Tumehifadhi kwamba hutaweza kuhudhuria. Ukibadili mawazo, unaweza kubadilisha jibu.
card.rsvpQueued: Jibu limehifadhiwa kwenye simu yako na litatumwa ukipata mtandao
card.rsvpClosed: Muda wa kujibu umeisha. Wasiliana na kamati kwa mabadiliko.
card.qrAlt: Msimbo wa QR wa kuingia; namba {code}
card.codeHelp: Huna QR? Mlangoni taja namba hii.
card.brightnessHint: Ongeza mwangaza wa skrini kabla ya kuonyesha QR
card.pledgeNone: Unaweza kuchangia harusi hii kwa simu.
card.invalidBody: Kiungo hiki si sahihi au kimeisha muda. Wasiliana na kamati.
card.reissuedBody: Kadi hii imebadilishwa; tumia kiungo kipya ulichotumiwa. QR ya zamani haitafanya kazi mlangoni.
card.eventPassedBody: Asante kwa kuwa sehemu ya siku hii. Majibu hayapokelewi tena.
card.installHint: Fungua menyu ya kivinjari kisha chagua "Ongeza kwenye skrini ya mwanzo".
card.openedOffline: Kadi hii itaonekana hata bila mtandao.

pay.title: Lipa mchango
pay.amountHelp: Salio lako ni {balance}. Unaweza kulipa sehemu.
pay.phoneHelp: Utapokea ombi la kuthibitisha kwenye simu hii.
pay.waitingBody: Tumetuma ombi la {amount} kwa {phone} kupitia {provider}. Weka PIN yako kwenye simu yako tu — usiitaje kwa mtu yeyote.
pay.notYet: Bado hatujapokea uthibitisho. Subiri kidogo kisha ujaribu tena.
pay.declinedBody: Mtandao wa malipo umekataa ombi. Hakuna pesa iliyokatwa. Hakikisha una salio la kutosha kisha ujaribu tena.
pay.timeoutBody: Hatukupata uthibitisho ndani ya sekunde 60. Kama ulithibitisha, bonyeza "Nimeshalipa". Vinginevyo jaribu tena.
pay.duplicateNote: Tumepokea taarifa ya malipo zaidi ya mara moja; imehesabiwa mara moja tu.
pay.safety: Hatutakuomba PIN au namba ya siri. Ombi la malipo linaonyesha jina la mtoa huduma tu.

short.enterBody: Weka namba ya kadi yako, mfano KH-4826
short.enterHelp: Namba iko kwenye SMS au kadi ya karatasi uliyopokea.

card.trustNever: We will never ask for a password, PIN or secret code.
card.partySizeHelp: You may bring up to {max, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
card.rsvpConfirmedBody: We saved your reply: {people}. Show this QR or your number at the gate.
card.rsvpDeclinedTitle: Thank you for letting us know
card.rsvpDeclinedBody: We saved that you can't attend. If your plans change, you can change your reply.
card.rsvpQueued: Your reply is saved on this phone and will be sent when you are online
card.rsvpFailed: Your reply was not sent. Please try again.
card.rsvpClosed: Replies are closed. Contact the committee for changes.
card.codeHelp: No QR? Say this number at the gate.
card.brightnessHint: Raise screen brightness before showing the QR
card.pledgePaidInFull: Thank you! Your pledge is fully paid.
card.pledgeNone: You can contribute to this wedding by phone.
card.invalidBody: This link is not valid or has expired. Please contact the committee.
card.reissuedBody: This card has been replaced; use the new link you were sent. The old QR will not work at the gate.
card.eventPassedTitle: This wedding has already taken place
card.eventPassedBody: Thank you for being part of the day. Replies are no longer accepted.
card.installHint: Open your browser menu and choose "Add to home screen".
card.openedOffline: This card will show even without a network.

pay.title: Pay contribution
pay.amountHelp: Your balance is {balance}. You can pay part of it.
pay.phoneHelp: You will receive a confirmation request on this phone.
pay.waitingBody: We sent a request for {amount} to {phone} via {provider}. Enter your PIN on your own phone only — never tell it to anyone.
pay.notYet: We have not received confirmation yet. Wait a moment and try again.
pay.declinedBody: The payment network declined the request. No money was taken. Check your balance and try again.
pay.timeoutBody: We did not receive confirmation within 60 seconds. If you confirmed, tap "I have paid". Otherwise try again.
pay.duplicateNote: We received the payment notice more than once; it was counted only once.
pay.noPledges: Payments are not enabled for this wedding.
pay.safety: We will never ask for your PIN or secret code. The payment request shows the provider name only.
